name: Granola
description: Granola is an AI notepad that takes meeting notes and offers AI chat across meetings, with desktop, iOS, Android and Apple Watch apps.
features: Integrations such as Notion, Zapier and HubSpot (Business)
strengths: Apps for desktop, iOS, Android and Apple Watch
limitations: Basic has a limited meeting history (30 days) and no integrations or API access

free.details: Basic is free: limited meeting history (30 days), auto model selection for chat, no API access or integrations.

pricing.regional: Currency shown as '$' without a code. Annual prices and regional pricing: not stated.

verification.notes: Product active. Basic $0, Business $14, Enterprise $35, all per user per month; the page does not state a billing period, so none is claimed. Business adds unlimited meeting history, advanced integrations, API access and MCP.
verification.method: Opened in the Claude desktop built-in browser; page text read

profile.headline: Meeting notes without a meeting bot

capabilities.title: Capture the meeting without a bot
capabilities.text: Granola listens to your computer's audio, so no bot joins the call. The site says it works with Zoom, Google Meet, Teams and other meeting apps.

capabilities.title: Get ready before the meeting
capabilities.text: It syncs with your calendar and prepares a Brief for external meetings: attendees, earlier discussion and current priorities.

capabilities.title: Write less, get clearer notes
capabilities.text: You type your own notes during the meeting and Granola uses the meeting context to turn them into clearer, personalised notes.

capabilities.title: Leave with the follow-ups done
capabilities.text: Notes, action items and follow-ups are ready when the meeting ends, with shortcuts such as List actions, Write follow-up email and Draft project plan.

featureCards.name: Granola Chat
featureCards.text: Ask questions across your meetings, for example what you committed to this week.

featureCards.name: Meeting Briefs
featureCards.text: A short preparation for external meetings built from your calendar.

featureCards.name: iOS and Android apps
featureCards.text: Use it for in-person meetings, walking meetings and phone calls, with voice typing.

featureCards.name: Private by default
featureCards.text: Notes are private unless you choose to share them with participants.

featureCards.name: MCP connector
featureCards.text: Connect Granola to AI apps such as Claude, OpenAI and Cursor so they can use your meeting notes.

audienceDetail.text: The product is aimed at people who spend the day in calls and want notes and actions handled.
The site links to a sales use-case page and mentions deal reviews.
The site links to a product management use-case page.
Stand-ups and go-to-market syncs are named as examples.

scenarios.title: Stand-ups and team syncs
scenarios.text: Keep your own notes short and let Granola produce the clear version and the action list.

scenarios.title: Deal reviews
scenarios.text: Walk into an external meeting with a Brief, then send the follow-up email it drafts.

scenarios.title: Looking back across meetings
scenarios.text: Ask Granola Chat what was decided or promised instead of searching old notes.

gettingStarted.text: It is free to download for macOS, Windows, iOS and Android.
This lets Granola detect upcoming meetings and prepare Briefs.

gettingStarted.step: Take notes in your next meeting
gettingStarted.text: Write as you normally would, then review the generated notes and action items.
